The '''Independent Traders' Infonet''' or '''ITI''' was a newsnet directed at [[free-trader]]s and other small-time merchants during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It informed them about relevant goings-on in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], such as correct use of permits and documents. Although licensed, it was closely monitored by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] authorities on the lookout for smugglers and other illegal trade activities.
